scope: Final bounded development-only feasibility study of canonical KGW SelfHash green-list ratio and logit bias; not a confirmatory false-positive, detection, or attack claim

parameter_family.gamma_0_10_excluded: Canonical SelfHash top-k-40 rejection would retain only about four candidates in expectation and the local gamma-0.25 path has already produced an empty rejection set.

stage_a.paired_randomness: same key-and-prompt-block seed for the unwatermarked control and all 12 candidates

stage_b.paired_randomness: same key-and-prompt-block seed for the unwatermarked control and the single frozen Stage-A selection

development_null_thresholds.policy: gamma x detector-key x model x length

detection_guardrail.interval: one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound reported descriptively, not used as the gate
detection_guardrail.global_rule: a candidate passes only if every explicitly named key x prefix-length cell reaches at least 80 strict detections out of 100

automated_quality_guardrails.reference: paired unwatermarked control for the same key and prompt block
automated_quality_guardrails.aggregation: paired key x prefix-length cell means over the same 100 prompts
automated_quality_guardrails.global_rule: every automated guardrail must pass in every explicitly named key x prefix-length cell

blinded_task_quality_guardrail.applies_to: every Stage-A candidate that first passes all automated detection and quality guardrails, and the single Stage-B candidate
blinded_task_quality_guardrail.selection: lowest frozen SHA-256 rank over eligible key x prompt pairs
blinded_task_quality_guardrail.blinding: prompt visible; candidate and paired unwatermarked response randomly labelled A/B independently for each pair; parameter identity hidden
blinded_task_quality_guardrail.pair_adjudication: candidate_unusable if either rater marks candidate unusable; candidate_worse only if both raters prefer control and neither marks an unusable response; all other non-unusable outcomes are non_worse
blinded_task_quality_guardrail.pass_rule: zero candidate-unusable pairs and at most 10 candidate-worse pairs out of 50

stage_a_selection_rule.eligibility: pass every detection, automated quality, and blinded task-quality guardrail
stage_a_selection_rule.primary_rank: smallest worst-cell conditional base-model NLL increase versus paired unwatermarked control

stop_rules.no_stage_a_candidate: close or prospectively rescope the 128-token canonical KGW claim; no further tuning
stop_rules.stage_b_failure: close or prospectively rescope the 128-token canonical KGW claim; no candidate substitution and no further tuning
stop_rules.stage_b_pass: permits drafting a new full null calibration-confirmation protocol; does not authorize that run or attacks

compute_budget.basis: linear planning from completed local CPU runs; uncertainty includes scoring mix and manual review
